propositions: The production LLM-Review gate must be cut over from direct Anthropic API to Bedrock inference profiles to dogfood the provider path actual users will take.

The cutover is a configuration act using three model-class environment variables (FRONTIER/STANDARD/TRIVIAL) in docker-compose.yml rather than a code change, preserving the per-pass model split (opus for Pass-1, sonnet for Pass-2/Pass-4).
Cross-provider fallback is deliberately absent so that Bedrock outages surface immediately on the gate that reviews every main landing, rather than being masked by a fallback to Anthropic.

The kill switch is subtractive only—deleting the three slot lines restores the Anthropic path by reverting to built-in class defaults—and the Anthropic credential is retained by design to make the switch functional.

The Bedrock provider package (pydantic-ai-slim[bedrock]) must be explicitly added to the container's uv sync install via the --extra bedrock flag, as it does not resolve from other dependencies despite boto3 being independently present.

Pre-cutover safety verification must include an induced VOTER_ERROR alarm transition, a Bedrock client-error alarm deployed and observing real traffic, and an end-to-end kill-switch execution returning the bot to Anthropic, all before the model-slot flip takes effect.
